title: Qualification Execution Broker MCP integration
summary: v0.2-dev8 optionally projects Qualification Execution Broker v0.1-dev1 into MCP as seven control/evidence tools while preserving worker execution as a separate authority.
invariants: qualification.plan performs preflight and never creates authorization state.
qualification.request freezes the exact runnable intent before human approval.
authorization.challenge exposes frozen intent/hash and public verification-key identities only.
authorization.submit accepts runId, approverKeyId and detached signature; never a private key.
status/results support long-running qualification beyond chat execution windows.
cancel cannot become an execute primitive.
No broker configured preserves the eight-tool project-only surface.

provenance.claim: MCP qualification tool count, schemas, dispatch and no-execute invariant.
Underlying qualification authority and local-key invariants.
